sources.title: Qwen3-8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series.
